items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: When I got with Art Tatum out in California I had only been playing about a year and a half

ctx.x: But I was still playing piano -- playing at the piano. But I could understand, I could play for dancers good, and they liked the way I played.

... When I got with Art Tatum out in California I had only been playing about a year and a half -- year, and seven months, somewhere like that. But you see those fellas when we got to California with Cite and the fiddle we got a few weeks work & then we didn't get any. And then we got a job to come back to the Apollo -- we had played there several times. All the way back from California to NY and pay your own fare, for a hundred and some dollars. The fare cost more than for me gettin back here. I just say, well…

... We used to go to this place called Lovejoys and sit around and jam. We did it every night and the first thing you know there was a crowd. And then Tatum used to come down & play and we had the place jumpin'. The guy would give us a sandwich and maybe a drink. And we come to find out, even now and then we'd look, we see a chain at the door & a crowd of people outside. Now he's gettin' a turnover makin' a handful of money and we ain't gettin' a dime.
